classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied speed rule and area instruction to form triangle-and-rectangle distance expressions, then equate the expressions as explicitly directed to find the overtaking time.

content.prompt:
Lindy is speeding in her car along a straight road at a constant speed of $20\text{ m/s}$ ($72\text{ km/h}$). She passes a stationary police motorcyclist, John. Three seconds later, John starts in pursuit. He accelerates for 6 seconds until he reaches his maximum speed, which he maintains until he overtakes Lindy. Let $t$ seconds be the time elapsed since Lindy passed John.

John’s speed, $v\text{ m/s}$, at any time until he reaches his maximum speed at $t=9$, is given by
$$v=5(t-3)\quad\text{for }3\le t\le9.$$

spec.description: Unplotted first-quadrant speed–time axes; time ticks 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 and speed ticks 10, 20, 30. No grid. The apparent radical-like source speed label is corrected to v.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal axis t in seconds; vertical axis v in metres per second.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent blank axes; no supplied answer curves.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Sketch the speed–time graph for Lindy.

answer.worked: Lindy’s speed is constant, so draw a horizontal line at $v=20$, starting at $t=0$.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: On the same set of axes, sketch John’s speed–time graph for $3\le t\le9$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}v(3)&=5(3-3)=0\\v(9)&=5(9-3)=30\end{align*}$$
Join $(3,0)$ and $(9,30)$ with a straight line.

children.label: iii
children.prompt: On the same set of axes, sketch John’s speed–time graph for $t\ge9$.

answer.worked: John maintains his maximum speed, so continue the graph horizontally from $(9,30)$ at $v=30$.

spec.description: One complete shared answer graph with direct series labels, preserving black source curves.
spec.mathematics: Lindy: v=20. John: v=5(t-3) for 3≤t≤9, then v=30.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer editions only; shared once by b(i)–b(iii).

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the value of $t$ when John and Lindy are travelling at equal speeds.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5(t-3)&=20\\t-3&=4\\t&=7\end{align*}$$
Their speeds are equal 7 seconds after Lindy passes John.

children.label: d
children.prompt: What is John’s acceleration (rate of change of speed) for $3\le t\le9$?

answer.worked:
Acceleration is the gradient of the speed–time graph.
$$\begin{align*}a&=\frac{30-0}{9-3}\\a&=5\text{ m/s}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: Given that the distance travelled by an object is equal to the area under its speed–time graph (above the $t$-axis), find:

children.label: i
children.prompt: the distance travelled by Lindy in the first 9 seconds

children.label: ii
children.prompt: an expression for the distance travelled by Lindy after $t$ seconds

answer.worked:
The area is a rectangle with width $t$ and height 20.
$$d_L=20t\text{ m}.$$

children.label: i
children.prompt: the distance travelled by John by the time he reaches his maximum speed

answer.worked:
The area is a triangle with base $9-3=6$ seconds and height $30\text{ m/s}$.
$$\begin{align*}d_J&=\frac12\times6\times30\\d_J&=90\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: the total distance travelled by John when $t=12$

answer.worked:
Add the triangular area to the rectangle from $t=9$ to $t=12$.
$$\begin{align*}d_J&=90+30(12-9)\\d_J&=180\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: iii
children.prompt: an expression for the total distance travelled by John, $t$ seconds after Lindy passed him, for $t\ge9$

answer.worked:
Add the initial triangular area to the rectangle of width $t-9$.
$$\begin{align*}d_J&=90+30(t-9)\\d_J&=90+30t-270\\d_J&=(30t-180)\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: i
children.prompt: Use your answers to parts e and f to find the value of $t$ when John draws level with Lindy.

answer.worked:
They draw level when their distances from the starting point are equal.
$$\begin{align*}30t-180&=20t\\10t&=180\\t&=18\end{align*}$$
This satisfies $t\ge9$.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: How far has John travelled by the time he draws level with Lindy?
